title: O9 — Counting distinct prime factors
exact_target: Can the number of distinct prime divisors be computed deterministically in time polynomial in the binary input length?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8400010 (AMR-083-0010). CC BY 4.0.
